# Memory Companion

> Memory Companion phones you, or a parent or grandparent, for a friendly 10-minute weekly chat, then turns the stories into a private family archive. No app. No typing. Just a phone call. It is in early access beta, opening soon.

## What it does

- We ring you, or your relative, on a mobile or landline at a time that suits. No app needed.
- Our AI asks warm, personal questions about life and memories, and follows the thread of what is said.
- Every call is transcribed and sorted by decade into a private family archive your family can read anytime.
- Recordings are kept only if the user chooses to keep them.
- Calls only happen with the person's agreement. The AI introduces itself at the start of every call.

## Privacy

Calls are transcribed. Recordings are kept only if you choose to keep them, and can be deleted at any time. Transcripts are private to your family.

## Pricing

- £15/month when the beta opens.
- Limited beta spots. No payment until then.
- Gift places are also £15/month once the beta opens. Gift reservations are open until 24 December.

## Status

Memory Companion is in early access beta, opening soon. It is not yet publicly available. People join a waitlist at https://memorycompanion.co.uk and are emailed when beta spots open.

## Key facts for citation

- Name: Memory Companion
- Category: family story archive by phone call
- Audience: families who want to preserve stories from a parent or grandparent, and people who want to record their own
- Region: United Kingdom (GB)
- Website: https://memorycompanion.co.uk
